camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnUserDomains --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key 1 --PageSize 20 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmv6jutt00' --DomainName 'example.com' --CheckDomainShow false --Coverage domestic --WebSiteType computing_routine --ChangeEndTime '2018-05-10T14:00:00Z' --PageNumber 1 --DomainSearchType fuzzy_match --Tag.1.Value 1 --ChangeStartTime '2018-05-10T12:00:00Z' --DomainStatus online
description_en: Call DescribeDcdnUserDomains to query all DCDN domain names under your account. This operation supports filtering by fuzzy match and domain status
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnUserDomains查询用户名下所有的DCDN域名，支持域名模糊匹配过滤和域名状态过滤
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-user-domains --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --domain-name example.com --domain-status online --domain-search-type fuzzy_match --check-domain-show false --resource-group-id rg-acfmv6jutt00 --change-start-time 2018-05-10T12:00:00Z --change-end-time 2018-05-10T14:00:00Z --coverage domestic --tag Value=1 Key=1 --web-site-type computing_routine --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnUserDomains

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. If you do not specify this parameter, all accelerated domain names under your account are returned
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名。如果不传该参数，默认不做域名匹配搜索，返回所有符合条件的域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the domain name. Valid values:

online: The domain name is enabled.

offline: The domain name is disabled.

configuring: The domain name is being configured.

configure_failed: The domain name failed to be configured.

checking: The domain name is under review.

check_failed: The domain name failed the review
parameters.help_zh:
域名状态过滤。
online：启用。
offline：停用。
configuring：配置中。
configure_failed：配置失败。
checking：正在审核。
check_failed：审核失败
parameters.name: domain_status

parameters.help_en:
The search method for the domain name. Valid values:

fuzzy_match: fuzzy match.

pre_match: prefix match.

suf_match: suffix match.

full_match (default): exact match.

If you specify a domain name but do not set this parameter, the system performs an exact match by default
parameters.help_zh:
域名查询类型。

fuzzy_match：模糊匹配。

pre_match：前匹配。

suf_match：后匹配。

full_match（默认值）：完全匹配。

传递了域名参数的情况下，不传DomainSearchType参数，则默认采用完全匹配模式
parameters.name: domain_search_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display domain names that are under review, failed the review, or failed to be configured. Valid values:

true: displays the domain names.

false: does not display the domain names
parameters.help_zh:
是否展示审核中、审核失败、配置失败的域名。取值：

true：展示。
false：不展示
parameters.name: check_domain_show

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 更新开始时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: change_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
更新结束时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: change_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The acceleration region. Default value: all. Valid values:

domestic: the Chinese mainland.

overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

global: global
parameters.help_zh:
加速区域：默认为全部。

domestic：仅中国内地。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）。
global：全球
parameters.name: coverage

fields.help_en: The key of tag N. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. You can call the TagDcdnResources operation to tag a domain name
fields.help_zh: 标签键，N的取值范围1~20。通过TagDcdnResources接口可以给域名设置Tag
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of tag N. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The business type. You can specify multiple types and separate them with commas (,). The default value is dynamic, which returns standard DCDN domain names. To query domain names for the computing service, set this parameter to computing_routine or computing_image
parameters.help_zh: 业务类型，多个用逗号隔开，默认值为dynamic，查询普通dcdn域名。查询计算服务类型域名时，传 computing_routine,computing_image
parameters.name: web_site_type

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
